name: dotted-map
blurb: SVG world map with dotted background grid and pulsing location markers.
description: Generates a stylized dotted world map from an SVG base. Accepts lat/lng markers that pulse on a loop. Dot grid is staggered and colors are customizable.
use_when: Displaying global presence, office locations, or customer distribution on a dashboard.
avoid_when: Accurate geographic data visualization or interactive mapping features.
a11y: Purely visual. Markers are SVG circles without semantic meaning or labels.
